# PoultryTrading

> Worldwide poultry business directory and trade enquiry platform, plus accounting software for poultry traders, retailers and farmers (India focus). Site: https://poultrytrading.com/

## Directory and trade

- [Poultry Business Directory](https://poultrytrading.com/directory/): searchable listings of hatcheries, farms, feed companies, processors, egg suppliers, equipment makers, vets and traders worldwide. Contact details are hidden.
- [Buy and Sell Enquiries](https://poultrytrading.com/leads/): live import, export and local poultry trade enquiries (anonymous).
- [List Your Business Free](https://poultrytrading.com/list-your-business/): add a business to the directory.
- [Import / Export Enquiry](https://poultrytrading.com/enquiry/import-export/): post a cross-border buy or sell requirement.
- [Local Trade Enquiry](https://poultrytrading.com/enquiry/local-trade/): post a local buy or sell requirement.
- [Contact](https://poultrytrading.com/contact/): support and partnership enquiries.

## Software (India)

- [Software overview](https://poultrytrading.com/software/): accounting and management software for poultry traders, retailers and farmers.
- [Poultry Trader Flow](https://poultrytrading.com/software/poultry-trader-flow/): billing, shrinkage tracking, credit ledger and daily reports for wholesale poultry traders. Available now.
- [Poultry Retailer Flow](https://poultrytrading.com/software/poultry-retailer-flow/): shop management software for retail chicken shops. Launching soon.
- [Poultry Farmer Flow](https://poultrytrading.com/software/poultry-farmer-flow/): farm management software for poultry farmers. In development.

## Main page

- [PoultryTrading home](https://poultrytrading.com/): overview of the directory and all software products.
